主要内容: TerraForm Global, Inc. (Nasdaq: GLBL), an indirect subsidiary of SunEdison, Inc. (NYSE: SUNE), has commented on SunEdison's Chapter 11 restructuring filing. TerraForm Global and its sister company, TerraForm Power, Inc. (Nasdaq: TERP), are not part of the SunEdison bankruptcy filing and have no plans to file for bankruptcy themselves. The equity interests of TerraForm Global and TerraForm Power in their respective wind and solar power plants are not available to satisfy SunEdison's creditors. TerraForm Global expects its fleet of power plants to continue operating and delivering clean electricity to customers in Brazil, India, China, South Africa, Uruguay, Thailand, and Malaysia. The company believes it has sufficient liquidity to operate its business and will continue to meet its financial obligations. TerraForm Global intends to coordinate with SunEdison to ensure uninterrupted operations. SunEdison is expected to continue providing asset management and operations and maintenance (O&M) services to TerraForm Global's power plants. SunEdison has secured $300 million in debtor-in-possession (DIP) financing. TerraForm Global's corporate-level revolving credit facility and indenture for its senior unsecured bonds do not include an event of default triggered by SunEdison's bankruptcy. The majority of its existing power purchase agreements (PPAs) do not allow the offtake counterparty to terminate the contract due to SunEdison's bankruptcy. Project-level financing agreements for some power plants may include event of default provisions related to SunEdison's bankruptcy or delays in audited financial statements. TerraForm Global is working with its project lenders to obtain waivers and/or forbearance agreements to address defaults. However, there is no assurance that such agreements will be secured. The company emphasizes that forward-looking statements in its communication are subject to risks and uncertainties, including the impact of SunEdison's bankruptcy filing on its operations, liquidity, and financial resources. These statements are based on current expectations and may change due to various factors, such as the outcome of SunEdison's Chapter 11 reorganization process, its ability to comply with its DIP financing facility, and potential legal proceedings. TerraForm Global does not undertake any obligation to update these forward-looking statements unless required by law.
